long_description:
🦃🔥 NEW JERSEY, LET’S GIVE THANKS AND TURN UP! 🔥🦃

This Thanksgiving, we’re bringing the squad together for the ultimate FRIENDSGIVING PARTY at Factory in Jersey City! Get ready for a night filled with Bollywood beats, unforgettable vibes, and memories with your favorite people. 🎉

🎧 DJ RAKESH is taking over the decks with the hottest Bollywood hits, desi bangers, and party anthems to keep you dancing all night long!

🎟️ FIRST 100 TICKETS ARE FREE!

Yes, you read that right! Grab your free tickets before they’re gone. Once the first 100 are claimed, ticket prices go up!

Event Details:

📅 Date: November 27th

⏰ Time: 10:00 PM – 2:00 AM

📍 Location: Factory | Jersey City, NJ

🔞Age: 21+ Event

Bring your friends, bring your energy, and let’s make this Friendsgiving one for the books! 🥂

🚨 Limited free tickets available — secure yours NOW before they’re gone!

 IMPORTANT NOTES - PLEASE READ 

* Be There Early To Avoid Long Lines

* All Tickets are Final and NO REFUNDS whatsoever

* CLUB has the right to refuse if capacity is reached. So COME EARLY

* VALID FORM OF ID : State issued ID / Driver License or Passport. NO other forms of identification will be accepted! Photocopies or pictures of your IDs on your phone will NOT be accepted.

* Space is limited, FIRST COME FIRST SERVE. (NO REFUNDS)

* This is a public event which will be recorded. You may appear in pictures/video recordings. We have full rights to use this media anywhere without seeking your prior or post permissions. 

Also check out other Parties in Jersey City.
